name: NASA Spacecraft Telemetry Anomaly Datasets (SMAP & MSL)
description: NASA Spacecraft Telemetry Anomaly Datasets comprise 82 incident telemetry time-series streams with 107 expert-labeled anomalous episodes from the Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP) satellite and Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Curiosity rover. Published at ACM SIGKDD 2018 by NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory, it provides a real-world benchmark for multivariate telemetry anomaly detection.
